faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.1.q: How long does a project take?
faq.1.a: It depends on the scope. We agree on a written schedule at the start, with dates for each delivery.
faq.2.q: Do I need my content ready?
faq.2.a: No. We help you organise the structure and base content before designing.
faq.3.q: Can I edit my site later?
faq.3.a: Yes. Every site comes with a guide to edit content without touching code.
faq.4.q: Do you work with clients anywhere?
faq.4.a: Yes. The whole process is remote, in Spanish or English.
